title: Better Ore Generation
description: A datapack that revamps stone and ores generation in Minecraft, each stone type ( diorite, calcite, tuff ) and ores can be found in larger quantities in their specific biomes.
body:
This datapack revamps Minecraft's ores and stone generation, each stone and ore now have their dedicated biome. Forcing the player to explore the world to get better tools AND to gather ressources even in late game.

- **Coal** : Plains, Forest, Dark Forest and Birch Forest
- **Copper** : Oceans, rivers and Dripstone caves
- **Iron** : Taiga, Snowy biomes , Dark Forest and Moutain biomes
- **Gold** : Badlands (vanilla)
- **Diamond** : Jungles
- **Lapis** : Swamp, Mangrove Swamp
- **Redstone** : Desert
- **Emerald** : Same as Vanilla but 4 times more common ( to make it actually interesting to mine for them instead of always trading in early game)

- **Clay** : Plains and Rivers
  ![Clay in a Plains biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02561a0ecc0be9fdfe0bea9a91bd7158bd9bff04.png)
- **Diorite** : Dark Forest
  ![Diorite in Dark Forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80458c71e5c696c942fbebd5e5fc899afc6f7478.png)
- **Granite** : Jungles and Desert
  ![Granite in Desert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d6ae98a4ff0e5c50f87a6415cd2071f216ed398_0.webp)
- **Andesite** : Birch Forest and Forests 
  ![Andesite in Forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61fbeb028a922faa28588c096dbb75605f336d01.png)
- **Tuff** : Savanna
  ![Tuff in Savanna](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/424fbdab9ff37490418eab5a9d887225d244fcaf.png)
- **Calcite** : Taiga, Windswept Forest and snowy biomes
  ![Calcite in Old Growth Taiga](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a30fd562d38586be77f960b63a29e6cf9ae9126.png)

Ore and Stone gen also have been decreased in biomes they're not specific to, they can still be found in any biome but in smaller amount.

I highly recommend you [RockQoL](https://modrinth.com/project/bMhlZTg5) datapack to be able to use any type of stone in crafting recipes

This Datapack is not compatible with other world gen datapack that affects **VANILLA** biomes and features.
